protocol: autonomous_learning_system_v1: integration of verified foundation blocks into one closed loop (belief + drive/goal + consolidation + intervention robustness). No external task: the system explores by confidence gap, learns, freezes consolidated rules, and applies them; intervention rebalances the identity distribution to check the rules are causal, not spurious. Controls: no_drive (random goals), no_consolidate (shared belief). Criterion: full coverage 1.0, application >= 0.9, intervention >= 0.85, no slower than no_drive, beats no_consolidate coverage by 0.2.
